# Pinterest Korea (kr.pinterest.com)

> Pinterest Korea is a visual discovery and curation platform featuring diverse content from language learning resources to K-pop fashion inspiration, greeting card designs, and fan art collections.

The Korean Pinterest platform hosts boards and idea collections spanning educational materials (ESL resources), cultural content (Kazakh and Central Asian themes), K-pop idol fashion and fanart, and DIY crafting projects. Content is organized by user profiles and themed collections across multiple languages including Korean, Russian, and Kazakh.

## Key Topics

- ESL Materials
- Language Learning
- K-pop Fashion
- Greeting Cards
- Fanart
- DIY Crafting
- Kazakh Culture
- Ahn Yujin
- IVE
- Conversation Practice
- Vocabulary Graphics
- Card Design
- Sewing Patterns
- Idol Styling
- Cultural Art

## Language Learning & ESL Resources

- [Print Discuss (printdiscuss) - Profile](https://kr.pinterest.com/printdiscuss/): Print Discuss profile showcasing ESL materials and language learning resources including conversation practice, vocabulary graphics, and news stories

## K-pop Fashion & Idol Inspiration

- [900+ Ahn Yujin Ideas](https://kr.pinterest.com/msh85648700497/안유진/): Ahn Yujin K-pop idol fashion and styling inspiration board with 900+ ideas featuring IVE and IZ*ONE member fashion
- [Female K-pop Idol GIFs](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/여돌-움짤/908221461117/): K-pop female idol GIFs and dance performance video clips collection

## Fan Art & Character Collections

- [Limbus Company Fanart](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/림버스-컴퍼니-만화/912539475083/): Limbus Company fanart and Project Moon character collection

## Cultural & Greeting Card Designs

- [Kazakh 8 March Greeting Cards](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/8наурыз-открытка-қазақша/897509900762/): Kazakh 8 March greeting card ideas and designs collection with decorative borders and cultural themes

## DIY & Sewing Projects

- [Women's Quilted Jacket Sewing Patterns](https://kr.pinterest.com/ideas/выкройка-фуфайки-женской/914164128543/): Women's quilted jacket sewing patterns and DIY ideas for crafting and garment construction
